mapper.sql: id, record_no, task_id, professional_type_id, professional_type_name, module_id, module_name, responsibility_id, responsibility_name, issue_id, issue_name, quality_id, quality_name, problem_type, problem_description, location, suggestion, photos, rectification_date, inspector, safety_score, record_status, create_user_id, create_time, update_time, deleted
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, u.username as create_user_name, task_dept.dept_name as department_name, resp_dept.dept_name as responsibility_name, t.task_no as task_no, t.inspection_time as inspection_time, r.rectification_date as rectification_deadline, leader.username as group_leader_name, deputy.username as deputy_leader_name FROM sys_monthly_inspection_record r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.create_user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept resp_dept ON r.responsibility_id = resp_dept.id LEFT JOIN sys_monthly_inspection_task t ON r.task_id = t.id LEFT JOIN sys_dept task_dept ON t.department_id = task_dept.id LEFT JOIN sys_user leader ON t.group_leader_id = leader.id LEFT JOIN sys_user deputy ON t.deputy_leader_id = deputy.id WHERE r.id = #{id} AND r.deleted = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_monthly_inspection_record WHERE create_user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT record_no FROM sys_monthly_inspection_record WHERE record_no IS NOT NULL ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
